description: One game's moneyline, spread or total: both sides on the consensus number, or which side the market has as the favorite. Name the game in plain words, for example Lions at Bears. Shows the scan time and a link to the game's page. Prices may have moved since the scan.

books.description: The books this person actually has. Omit for the default set.

favored.description: Who the market favors, as a price.

game.description: The game in plain words, for example 'Lions at Bears' or 'Yankees tonight'.

line.description: The spread or total the bet is at. Omit for a moneyline, or to use the consensus line.

side.description: home or away for a moneyline or spread; over or under for a total.

name: game_lines

as_of.description: When the prices were scanned, Eastern Time.

card.description: The same answer, structured, when there is one.

decline_kind.description: Set when the question is one we do not answer, and which kind.

ok.description: True when the tool produced an answer.

options.description: When the question could mean more than one thing: whole questions to ask again with.

stale.description: True when that scan is older than usual for our hourly snapshot.

state_note.description: Where to check what is legal for you.

title: Game Lines
